docs.title: Ferry Company Adds Electric Vessels
docs.body:
STOCKHOLM — Baltic Link, which operates ferries between Stockholm and the islands of the archipelago, will add three electric vessels to its fleet next summer. The new ferries, built by a shipyard in Gdańsk, can carry 150 passengers each and recharge in fifteen minutes at the docks. [1]

According to the company, the vessels will reduce its fuel consumption by about a quarter. [2] Passengers will also notice a difference: the electric engines are much quieter than diesel ones.

Ticket prices will not change, the company said. [3] If the new vessels perform well, Baltic Link plans to replace its entire fleet by 2032. [4]

questions.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: A transportation company introducing new boats
questions.evidence: will add three electric vessels to its fleet next summer
questions.explanation: L'article annonce l'arrivée de trois ferries électriques dans la flotte de Baltic Link.

questions.prompt: What is NOT mentioned about the new vessels?
questions.explanation: Capacité (150 passagers), recharge (15 minutes) et chantier (Gdańsk) sont cités ; le prix d'achat ne l'est pas.

questions.prompt: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "They will initially serve the busiest route, between Stockholm and Vaxholm."
questions.explanation: « They » reprend « the new ferries » décrits juste avant [1] ; la phrase complète la présentation des navires avant le paragraphe sur les économies.
questions.takeaway: Les pronoms (they) renvoient au sujet de la phrase précédente.

docs.title: Banque Rhône-Alpes
docs.subtitle: To our Rue Garibaldi branch customers
docs.body:
Dear Customer,

We are writing to let you know that, from 1 March, our Rue Garibaldi branch will change its opening hours. The branch will be open from 10 A.M. to 6 P.M., Tuesday to Saturday, instead of 9 A.M. to 5 P.M., Monday to Friday. This change follows a customer survey in which many respondents said they could only visit the branch after work or on weekends.

Our cash machines will remain available 24 hours a day. You can also manage your accounts at any time through our mobile app.

If you have an appointment with your advisor on a Monday after 1 March, he or she will contact you to reschedule.

Sincerely,
Banque Rhône-Alpes

docs.title: Four-Day Week Trial Pays Off at Codexa
docs.body:
Last year, Lisbon-based software company Codexa let its 120 employees work four days a week for six months without any reduction in pay. The results, published this week, were striking. Productivity, measured by completed projects, remained stable, while sick days fell by 35 percent. [1]

Not every team adapted easily, however. Customer support, which must answer calls five days a week, had to introduce a rotation system so that the help desk was always staffed. [2]

Following the trial, Codexa has decided to make the four-day week permanent. [3] Chief executive Rui Matos admitted that he had been skeptical at first. "I expected our output to fall," he said. "Instead, people became more focused." [4]

questions.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: The opening of a new office
The results of a work-schedule experiment
questions.evidence: The results, published this week, were striking.
questions.explanation: L'article présente les résultats de l'essai de la semaine de quatre jours.

questions.prompt: The word "striking" in paragraph 1, line 3, is closest in meaning to
questions.evidence: were striking
questions.explanation: « Striking results » = des résultats frappants, remarquables.
questions.traps: « Strike » signifie aussi frapper ou faire grève : sens inadaptés ici.

questions.prompt: Why did the customer support team need a special arrangement?
options: It had to remain available five days a week.
It worked in a different country.
questions.evidence: which must answer calls five days a week
questions.explanation: Le support doit répondre cinq jours sur sept : un roulement a été mis en place.

questions.prompt: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "Employee surveys also showed a sharp rise in job satisfaction."
questions.explanation: « Also » ajoute un résultat positif à ceux du premier paragraphe (productivité stable, arrêts maladie en baisse).
questions.takeaway: « Also » s'insère après une liste de résultats du même type.

Luca Moretti
